note: Different phases overlap. Union removes overlap only within each phase. Pin events are assigned by import timestamp window; background work can overlap. Span duration rounding affects interval estimates. Syscalls are assigned by start time in the same run. pin_ledger_sync_partition assigns each ledger syscall exactly once by overlapping writer stage names at its start; combined labels preserve ambiguity and outside_writer_stages preserves unmatched calls. outside_writer_lifecycle_partition further partitions unmatched writer calls using complete lifecycle spans, including background work without an import parent. Span CLOSE context may differ from its creation context; writer classification uses complete recorded lifetimes, which can include time retained by child spans. This is temporal correlation, not causal attribution.
